name: Neha Singh
subtitle: Digital Marketing  Batch - 2024
review: The GenAI modules in Workskills really set this program apart from other digital marketing courses. Learning how to use AI for content creation, campaign analysis, and customer engagement gave me a huge advantage. The case studies on real brands helped me apply concepts directly. Within 2 months, I was confident enough to run ad campaigns on my own.

name: Rohit Agarwal
subtitle: Digital Marketing Batch - 2024
review: I liked how the course was structured with live practice labs for SEO, SEM, and AI driven marketing tools. The trainers were quite good and always open to doubts. The GenAI integration showed how automation can save time in campaign reporting and keyword research. A great learning investment overall.

name: Marketing Intern
subtitle: Digital Marketing Internship - 2024
review: My internship experience with Workskills was excellent. They gave us exposure to AI based ad optimization tools which made me understand how campaigns can scale efficiently. The mentors reviewed my work regularly and provided detailed feedback. This practical exposure boosted my confidence before entering the industry.

name: Content Strategist
subtitle: Digital Marketing + AI Batch - 2024
review: Good balance between traditional marketing fundamentals and the latest AI driven strategies. The only area I felt could improve was more depth in influencer marketing, but overall the program gave me strong insights into how GenAI can help in building scalable marketing strategies.

name: Anjali Sharma
subtitle: Digital Marketing + AI Tools Batch - 2024
review: I enrolled in this course after struggling with freelancing projects. The AI-powered modules on ad copywriting and analytics dashboards were a game changer. Now I can deliver faster results to my clients. I even landed 2 long-term projects just by showcasing my portfolio built during the course.

name: u/marketerAI
subtitle: Digital Marketing Batch - 2024
review: Just wrapped up the Workskills GenAI marketing course. What I liked most was the weekly challenges where we had to use AI tools to generate campaign insights. It wasn’t just theory  they pushed us to actually apply tools like ChatGPT and analytics platforms to real case studies. Highly recommend to anyone who wants to stay ahead in marketing.

name: Aditya Rao
subtitle: Digital Marketing + AI Automation Batch - 2024
review: The placement support team was very active. They helped me refine my CV which made me stand out in interviews. I got an offer within weeks of finishing the program. The mix of practical campaigns,and strong mentorship makes this course worth it.

name: u/creativehustler
subtitle: Digital Marketing Batch - 2024
review: It’s a good course overall. I really enjoyed the content strategy part, and the AI tools made it much easier for me to come up with ad copies and blog ideas. I just felt the marketing analytics section could have gone a bit deeper, but overall, it was a very useful experience.

name: Mansi Gupta
subtitle: Digital Marketing + GenAI Batch - 2024
review: Honestly, this course gave me the clarity I was looking for. The trainers explain things in a very simple way, and the AI-based tools made creating ad copies and campaign reports much easier. I could actually apply what I learned to my own freelance projects. Very happy with the experience!

name: Harshit Meena
subtitle: Digital Marketing Batch - 2024
review: The best part for me was how practical everything was. Instead of just theory, we got to work on real examples and campaigns. The GenAI lessons showed me how to save time while still being creative. Only wish there were a few more case studies, but overall I found it very helpful.

name: Marketing Trainee
subtitle: Digital Marketing Internship - 2024
review: Workskills gave me my first proper exposure to digital marketing tools. During the internship, I got to use AI features for campaign tracking and reporting, which made learning fun and realistic. The mentors were supportive and guided us patiently. Good experience for a beginner like me.

name: Shivani Nair
subtitle: Digital Marketing + AI Tools Batch - 2024
review: I joined because I wanted to switch careers, and I’m glad I did. The course covers SEO, social media, and AI tools in a way that even beginners can follow. I especially liked the live projects because they helped me build confidence. I would recommend this to anyone starting fresh in marketing.

name: u/adcreator21
subtitle: Digital Marketing Batch - 2024
review: Pretty good learning experience overall. The sessions on AI for content planning were amazing , and I’ve already started using some of those tools for my small business. Could have included a bit more on influencer marketing, but otherwise I’m satisfied with what I learned.

name: Deepak Sharma
subtitle: Digital Marketing + GenAI Batch - 2024
review: I liked how everything was explained step by step. The dashboard is simple to use, and the trainers made sure no one was left behind. Learning about AI in marketing was the highlight for me—it showed how easy it can be to speed up tasks without losing creativity. Definitely worth it.
